project_title: TellCo Telecommunication User Analytics & Interactive Web App
author: kakkarot23

slides.title: TellCo Telecommunication User Analytics
slides.subtitle: End-to-End Investment Due Diligence & Subscriber Intelligence
key_points: 106,893 Active Subscribers Analyzed
41.1% Apple Market Share Leader
54% Gaming & Streaming Traffic Dominance
Random Forest Satisfaction Model R^2 = 0.9983
Investment Thesis: BUY — Undervalued Target (+25-30% ARPU potential)
slides.ai_prompt: Create an executive dark-themed cover slide for a telecom acquisition due diligence report titled 'TellCo Telecommunication User Analytics' with metrics: 106k users, 41% Apple share, 54% gaming traffic, and BUY recommendation.

slides.title: Task 1: User Overview Analysis & Handset Ecosystem
slides.subtitle: Exploratory Data Analysis, Decile Segmentation & PCA
key_points: Top Handsets: iPhone 12, Galaxy S20, iPhone 11 Pro
Manufacturer Breakdown: Apple (41.1%), Samsung (34.7%), Huawei (14.3%)
Decile Class Duration: Top 10% users consume >42% total duration
PCA Component Drivers: PC1 (52.3% variance) captures traffic, PC2 (18.6%) captures duration
slides.ai_prompt: Create a 2-column slide showing telecom handset ecosystem statistics: Top manufacturers (Apple 41.1%, Samsung 34.7%), top devices (iPhone 12, Galaxy S20), and PCA variance breakdown.

slides.title: Task 2: User Engagement Analysis & K-Means Clustering
slides.subtitle: Session Frequency, Duration & Bandwidth Aggregation (k=3 Clusters)
key_points: Metrics: Session Frequency, Total Duration, Total Traffic Bytes
K-Means Optimal k=3: Elbow Method WCSS inflection point
Cluster 0 (Low Engagement): 62% of subscribers
Cluster 1 (Medium Engagement): 28% of subscribers
Cluster 2 (High Engagement / Power Users): 10% of subscribers driving 54% total traffic
slides.ai_prompt: Create a slide on telecom user engagement clustering with 3 segments: Cluster 0 Low (62%), Cluster 1 Medium (28%), Cluster 2 High (10% users driving 54% traffic), and highlight K-Means Elbow Method.

slides.title: Task 3: Experience Analytics & Network Quality
slides.subtitle: Throughput, TCP Retransmissions & Latency RTT
key_points: Average Throughput: 12.4 Mbps DL bearer throughput (Apple: 14.2 Mbps)
TCP Retransmissions: 3G devices suffer 3x higher packet loss (>450KB retransmissions)
RTT Latency: Network average 52ms (Gaming sessions peak at 110ms)
Experience Clustering: Classifies users into Outstanding, Satisfactory, and Degraded Network Experience
slides.ai_prompt: Create a slide titled 'Network Experience Analytics' showing metrics for Throughput (12.4 Mbps), Latency RTT (52ms), and TCP Retransmission loss per handset type.

slides.title: Task 4: User Satisfaction & Machine Learning Regression
slides.subtitle: Random Forest Predictive Model (R^2 = 0.9983)
key_points: Satisfaction Score: Euclidean distance between Engagement & Experience scores
Random Forest Performance: R^2 = 0.9983, RMSE = 0.0164, MSE = 0.00027
Feature Importance: Engagement Score (54%) & Bearer Throughput (31%) drive satisfaction
Satisfaction Clusters: K-Means k=2 segments subscribers into High Satisfaction (78%) vs Dissatisfied (22%)
slides.ai_prompt: Create a slide on Telecom Satisfaction Machine Learning featuring Random Forest R^2 = 0.9983, RMSE = 0.0164, Feature Importance bar chart, and Euclidean score formulas.

slides.title: Task 4.6 & MLOps: Database Export & Query Execution
slides.subtitle: SQLite Export, Custom SQL Execution & MLflow Tracking
key_points: SQLite Exporter: Writes user satisfaction metrics to data/tellco_analytics.db
SQL Query Runner: Embedded interactive query engine for custom business reporting
MLOps Experiment Tracker: Logs hyperparameters, RMSE, MSE, R^2 metrics, and timestamps
CI/CD Pipeline: Automated pytest test suite covering data cleaning, engagement, and ML
slides.ai_prompt: Create a slide showcasing database export and MLOps tracking: SQLite database integration, interactive SQL query runner, and experiment tracking logs.

slides.title: Power BI Integration & Strategic Action Plan
slides.subtitle: Star-Schema Data Model, DAX Measures & Investment Roadmap
key_points: Power BI Ecosystem: Pre-built 1-click PBIDS, PBIP, and Star Schema tables (Fact_Subscriber_Sessions, Dim_Handset_Device)
DAX Measures: Pre-computed Gaming Traffic %, Throughput kbps, and Satisfaction Index
Strategic Action 1: Introduce gaming bandwidth prioritization packages (+15% revenue impact)
Strategic Action 2: Target 3G handset upgrade promo to transition budget users to 4G/5G
Final Valuation Conclusion: STRONG BUY recommendation for TellCo Telecommunication
slides.ai_prompt: Create a conclusion slide for a telecom M&A deck featuring a Power BI star-schema summary, DAX KPIs, 3 strategic growth initiatives, and a final BUY recommendation.
